row.title: SPARK-IDLE-1, NATIVE-STUB-1: a tuned knob broke main, stub PRs held the agent cap, the executor woke itself every minute
row.body: test_pm read the live chain.max_runs_per_day, so the product manager's own tune (4 to 5) failed checks on every branch; the fixture now pins its start value. The executor chain counted attempts only, so gated runs re-woke it about once a minute (1,149 runs in 14 h); doctrine/clocks.json chain.max_wakes_per_hour bounds wake-ups. The Worker-native executor opened three stub PRs for one item; stubGuard refuses placeholder files and files outside code roots, and an item with an open worker PR is skipped.
